hints: Look carefully at how to read skeletal formulae, remember each bend is a carbon and you must add in the hidden hydrogens to get the molecular formula first.
Count atoms for arginine to get $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2$, then think about what you divide by to get the simplest whole number ratio.
Calculate $M_r$ from the full molecular formula using 12, 1, 14 and 16, then check which empirical formula and $M_r$ pair matches together.
walkthrough:
**Read the skeletal formula correctly**

Start by expanding the zig-zag chain. Each end and each bend is a carbon with enough hydrogens to make four bonds.

For arginine: $\text{H}_2\text{N}-\text{C}(=\text{NH})-\text{NH}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{NH}_2)-\text{COOH}$

**Find the molecular formula of arginine**

Now count every atom carefully, including H on heteroatoms.

C: 1 (guanidine) + 3 (chain) + 1 (alpha) + 1 (acid) = 6

H: 2 + 1 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 14

N: 4, O: 2

So molecular formula is: $$\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2$$

**Simplify to the empirical formula**

Empirical means simplest whole number ratio. All subscripts in $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2$ divide by 2.

$$\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{N}_2\text{O}$$

**Calculate $M_r$ and choose the row**

Use $A_r$: C = 12, H = 1, N = 14, O = 16.

$$M_r = (6 \times 12) + (14 \times 1) + (4 \times 14) + (2 \times 16) = 72 + 14 + 56 + 32 = 174$$

Empirical $\text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{N}_2\text{O}$ with $M_r$ 174 for arginine matches one row exactly.

options.A: Correct. Arginine is $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2$, which simplifies to $\text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{N}_2\text{O}$, and $M_r = 174$. Both values in this row are accurate.
options.B: Incorrect. The H count is too high. Students often add one extra H to a nitrogen or carbon when expanding the skeletal formula, giving $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{16}\text{N}_4\text{O}_2$ and $M_r = 176$. Careful counting gives 14 H, not 16.
options.C: Incorrect. Lysine is $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_2\text{O}_2$, so the empirical formula $\text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{NO}$ is right, but $M_r$ is 146, not 144. The value 144 comes from using 12 H instead of 14 H.
options.D: Incorrect. Lysine $M_r = (6 \times 12) + (14 \times 1) + (2 \times 14) + (2 \times 16) = 146$ is correct, but the empirical formula is wrong. $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\text{N}_2\text{O}_2$ simplifies to $\text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{NO}$, not $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8\text{NO}$.
